# Exercise an entire long stateful campaign (including decoding desired state,
# guard scoping, model result witnesses, and output message append).
import sys
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/project/src','/workspace/project/tests']
from test_campaign import campaign,module,ktest
from eywa.offline import execute
states=['s'+str(i) for i in range(2048)]
types=[dict(name='State',kind='enum',values=states),dict(name='Msg',kind='string',maxsize=3),dict(name='B',kind='bool')]
c=campaign(types,[module('entry',[['state','State'],['message','Msg']],['result','B'])])
# Every repeated guard is the same source; it sees the recovered target, not
# the intermediate states along the path.
guard=['eq',['var','state'],['const','State',states[-1]]]
c['machine']=dict(states=states,initial='s0',state_param='state',message_param='message',transitions=[dict(**{'from':states[i],'to':states[i+1]},command='next',cost=65535,when=guard) for i in range(len(states)-1)])
obj=[('x0',(len(states)-1).to_bytes(4,'little')),('x2',b'a'),('x3',b'\0'),('x4',b'b'),('x5',b'\0')]
c['runs']=[dict(entry='entry',ktest=ktest(obj))]
answer=execute(c)
assert answer['records'][0]['status']=='READY'
case=answer['corpus'][0]
assert case['cost']==2047*65535 and len(case['commands'])==2048 and case['commands'][-1]=='a'
print('long stateful PASS',len(case['commands']),case['cost'])
